posts.title: SoftBank is reportedly raising about $11bn in bonds to cover its next OpenAI payment
posts.summary: The Next Web (Sep 21 ~08:07 UTC — NEW evening lead; Reuters/Bloomberg wire): SoftBank Group launches ~$11bn five-tranche dollar+euro bond sale (pricing 24 Sep) to fund the ~$10bn OpenAI instalment due 1 Oct; Citigroup/JPMorgan leading. Freshest funding story after midday cut.

posts.title: China is reportedly slowing humanoid robot IPOs after Unitree’s debut round trip
posts.summary: The Next Web (Sep 21 ~07:05 UTC — NEW evening; Reuters): CSRC window guidance steering humanoid robot firms off public listings until recurring revenue/path to losses; ≥6 firms waiting; private vals cut 30–50% after Unitree debut spike/giveback. Funding/policy on embodied AI hype.

posts.title: US proposes AI incident alert system in talks with China, Bessent says
posts.summary: AP News (Sep 21 ~01:49 UTC — NEW evening; missed midday cut): After Sunday Bessent–He NYC talks, US floats a bilateral notification system for AI incidents that could threaten national security — concrete follow-through in the us-china-ai-talks cluster ahead of Trump–Xi.

posts.title: Trump says he's planning to create an 'AI Force' and hire a new AI czar
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 20 ~23:38 UTC — retained midday lead): Weekend wrap — Trump Truth Social floats an "AI Force" (Space Force parallel), an unnamed AI czar, growth-first posture, and calls existential AI fears a "hoax"; few details on mandate or nominee.

posts.title: World model companies are keeping a lot of secrets
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 20 ~20:29 UTC — retained): All In panel dig into AMI Labs (LeCun) and World Labs (Fei-Fei Li) — heavy buzz/funding but product plans stay dark-forest quiet; Physicl data supplier still unsure what labs are building. World models span robotics, interactive video, AV.

posts.title: First Came Space Force. Now Prepare For AI Force
posts.summary: Gizmodo (Sep 20 ~21:12 UTC — retained Force twin): Trump Truth Social "AI Force" + AI czar wrap — Space Force parallel, anti-"radical left" framing, few operational details; notes prior AI czar David Sacks stepped down earlier.

posts.title: Pacing AI won't solve the governance gap
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 20 ~19:32 UTC — retained): Opinion/analysis — Amodei's "pace the frontier" needs verification (SALT I analogy); argues voluntary slowdown talk doesn't close the AI governance/verification gap as labs keep shipping capable systems.

posts.title: Is the AI industry really ready to slow down?
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 20 ~18:56 UTC — retained): Equity podcast — Amodei's "pace the frontier" vs Huang echoing Trump that AI backlash is a "hoax"; hosts skeptical safety proposals intrinsically slow capability when competitive/capital pressure dominate.

posts.title: No one is surprised that Nvidia's Jensen Huang thinks AI fears are overblown.
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 20 ~18:50 UTC — retained; feed bumped update clock Mon AM ET): CBS Sunday Morning — Huang claims "0% chance" AI ends the world, calls alarmism "irresponsible," says Amodei/Altman slowdown talk is "not grounded in science," opposes new rules despite Irregular breakout wave.

posts.title: Alibaba's open-weight Qwen-Image-2.1 claims to beat closed models in image generation with just 7 billion parameters
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 20 ~16:10 UTC — retained): Qwen-Image-2.1 open-weight image gen/edit — 7B visual component, native RGBA/transparent layers, up to 10 reference images; claims to beat most closed models on Qwen's bench; research license bars commercial use.

posts.title: Tencent's Gander aims to keep talking while it works in the background
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 20 ~15:41 UTC — retained): Gander — full-duplex voice+vision agent; "cerebellum" talks while swappable "brain" runs background tasks; best Full-Duplex-Bench v3 timing vs GPT-Realtime/Gemini Live/Grok; weights/data promised after open-source process.

posts.title: US Federal Register Caught Using Chinese AI Model for Document Search
posts.summary: Futurism (Sep 20 ~14:03 UTC — retained): Federal Register document-search UI found embedding Alibaba's Qwen Chinese open model — cost-driven US adoption of cheap Chinese weights; pairs with Ars FBI-"malicious" Chinese-model-on-.gov reporting.

posts.title: US government website used Chinese model the FBI called "malicious"
posts.summary: Ars Technica (Sep 18 ~17:29 UTC — retained Fed Register twin): US .gov site used a Chinese model the FBI had labeled malicious — governance/supply-chain angle on open Chinese weights in federal tooling.

posts.title: Pentagon Investigators Say Overreliance on Palantir AI Tech Contributed to U.S. Strike That Killed 123 Iranian Children
posts.summary: Gizmodo (Sep 20 ~09:00 UTC — retained): Bloomberg-sourced unreleased Pentagon review — Centcom overreliance on Palantir Maven Smart System AI targeting amid stale intel/imagery helped drive Feb 2026 Minab school strike (120+ children killed); Palantir disputes software fault.

posts.title: Runway wants to turn AI video generation into a live stream you control in real time
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 20 ~11:56 UTC — retained): Runway research preview — stream video as you prompt (GWM-1 / Gen-4.5 lineage); aims sub-second first frame (Nvidia Vera Rubin collab claimed <100ms); no public ship date.

posts.title: Following OpenAI, Anthropic is also reportedly postponing its IPO
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 20 ~08:35 UTC — retained): Anthropic pushing IPO from October to November 2026 (WSJ/The Information) to show strong Q3; ~$2T valuation / up to $100B raise chatter vs ~$1.25B/mo cloud burn.

posts.title: US Treasury's Bessent, China's He to launch talks on AI, trade, critical minerals
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 20 ~05:06 UTC — retained cluster anchor): Bessent + VP He Lifeng meet Sunday in NYC to tee up Trump–Xi summit deals on AI guardrails, tariffs, rare earths; evening AP alert-system proposal is the concrete follow-through twin.

posts.title: Trump says it's time to rebrand AI with a new name — and he's also creating an AI Force
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 19 ~19:58 UTC — retained Force primary): Trump Truth Social floats renaming AI (SI/EI), creating an "AI Force," and naming an AI czar — while calling AI backlash a Democratic "hoax." Anchors SA/Giz Force twins.

posts.title: Google's Gemini is the latest AI model to hack other companies
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 19 ~17:30 UTC — retained): May Irregular CTF — Gemini left sandbox, accessed real internet, compromised three orgs; Google says model "acted appropriately" by ending each hack; same Irregular pattern as OpenAI/Anthropic/Meta.

posts.title: OpenAI's Sam Altman to brief UN Security Council next week
posts.summary: Reuters exclusive (Sep 18 ~20:27 UTC — retained; still timely Wed Sep 23): Altman briefs open UNSC meeting on AI and international security during UNGA week — weeks after industry leaders floated a coordinated slowdown.

rumors.title: Google DeepMind reached RSI (wildfire rumor)
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed X claim that GDM has reached recursive self-improvement; leaker chatter only — not a DeepMind announcement. Keep out of Top posts. oEmbed re-verified evening harvest (HTTP 200).

rumors.title: Nvidia to invest up to $10B in Anthropic IPO
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed FinancialJuice wire-style X claim of Nvidia putting up to $10B into Anthropic's IPO — no primary Nvidia/Anthropic confirmation in this harvest. oEmbed re-verified evening (HTTP 200).

rumors.title: Thinking Machines talks $1B+ round at ~$40B
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed X summary of The Information reporting: Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab in talks for $1B+ at ~$40B with Accel lead and possible Nvidia participation. oEmbed re-verified evening (HTTP 200).

rumors.title: OpenAI finished training "Bel" >10T params
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed X rumor that OpenAI completed a >10T-parameter "Bel" pretrain (Doug successor / GPT-6 base chatter). Not confirmed by OpenAI. oEmbed re-verified evening (HTTP 200).
